newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai GDP grows 12.3 pct in first two months.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai GDP grows 12.3 pct in first two months.

text.p: Shanghai's gross domestic product (GDP) for the first two months of 1997 was 43.2 billion yuan ($5.2 billion), a 12.3 percent increase over the same period last year, the Shanghai Securities News said on Saturday.
It said GDP in February was 19.863 billion yuan, 11.4 percent more than February 1996, while industrial output for the month was 33.32 billion yuan, 10.8 percent over the same month last year.
Retail sales for the month were valued at 11.032 billion yuan, a rise of 4 percent over February 1996 when adjusted for consumer price inflation, the newspaper said.
